text:
nina: FYI perf alert  host p99 up ~20% on small streaming requests since kv-cache warmup refactor. Traces attached.

harry: repro? which pool?

nina: rtx-dedicated. Repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' -d '{"model":"redwood-rtl-2048","input":"hi"}'

devon: flame top: parse::validate_prefix (31%), token::scan (22%), kv::warm_prefix_v2 (17%), grpc::writev (14%), batching::heuristic_decide (9%), other 7%.

mira: looks like warm_prefix runs on enqueue per-request and re-walks tiny chunk buffers. That plus smallwrite fragmentation forces kernel fallback and extra copies.

harry: short-term: gate warm_prefix for tiny chunked requests (chunk_count < 3 && total_bytes < 2048) and emit metric parse.warm_skipped. Medium: make prefix cache per-connection. Long: change batching heuristic to coalesce before warmup.

nina: opened PR with gate behind feature flag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4880

deploy-bot: canary starting on rtx-dedicated-canary (4 hosts) image=runtime:pr-4880 ramp=30m link=https://canary.redwood.dev/4880

devon: will prototype incremental per-conn prefix cache and a kernel-picker hint when fragmentation detected to avoid fallback copy. Also evaluate ingress micro-coalesce 1-2ms to reduce writev syscalls.

harry: added small perf-harness test that simulates fragmented chunked frames + kv warmup so we catch regressions.

nina: canary 15m snapshot: p95 -10%, p99 -16%, host CPU -8%, parse.warm_skipped ~62% on tiny requests.

mira: promising. Action items: 1) collect 3h canary data; 2) land per-connection prefix cache; 3) change batching heuristic to prefer coalesce before warmup; 4) add kernel.choice telemetry. Ticket INF-1340.

harry: snippet from the gate in PR4880: 
```
if (chunk_count < 3 && total_len < 2048) {
  metrics.incr("parse.warm_skipped");
  return;
}
```

nina: posting flame links & canary dashboard to INF-1340. Thanks team.

mira: nice catch. :clap:
